By this interim application, the applicant seeks the  following substantive relief;
 "(a) That this Hon'ble Court be pleased to suspend the  purported Look-Out Circular issued against the applicant by  the Respondent No.2 on recommendation of the  Respondent No.1 for a period of 29 days commencing from  20th June, 2023 till 18th July, 2023."
3. Perused the papers.

It appears that the applicant is  arraigned as an accused in connection with C.R.No. 786 of 2022  registered with the Vakola Police Station (subsequently transferred to  EOW, Unit-V, Mumbai and re-registered as C.R.No.121 of 2022), for  the alleged offences punishable under Sections 409, 420 r/w 34 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 3,4,8 and 13 of the Maharashtra  Ownership of Flats (Regulation of the promotion of construction, sale,
 management and transfer) Act, 1963.

sentences.text: Considering the aforesaid and the fact that the applicant
has travelled earlier and has returned back to India and having regard

to the purpose for which the applicant intends to travel to London, the  application is allowed on the following terms and conditions:-
 ORDER (i) The applicant - Akhtar Hasan Rizvi is permitted to travel abroad during the period from 20th June, 2023 to 18th July, 2023;

(ii) The applicant, before his departure, to furnish the full itinerary of his overseas travel with all details, including the address where he would stay, telephone/mobile/contact numbers, on which he can be contacted, during the said period to the concerned officer of the 2. IA 2090-2023 .doc Respondent No.1 - EOW, before his departure;
(iii) In order to enable the applicant to travel to London from 20 th June, 2023 to 18th July, 2023,
the LOC issued against the applicant by the Respondent No.2- Union of India on the recommendation of the Respondent No.1 - EOW, is suspended from 20 th June, 2023 to 19th July,
2023.
(iv) The applicant to inform the office of the Respondent No.1 - EOW of his return within one week of his return.

(v) The Immigration Authorities on all points of departure, will permit the applicant to pass through immigration and to board his flight or flights irrespective of whether the immigration system has been updated and whether the Respondent No.1 - EOW has informed the Immigration Authorities or not.

8. Learned Counsel for the respondent Nos.1 and 2 to communicate this order to the Immigration Authorities forthwith and 2. IA 2090-2023 .doc in any event, within 24 hours of this order being uploaded.
9. Interim Application is disposed of on the aforesaid terms.
10. All concerned to act on the authenticated copy of this order.
